adds.title: Iranian Railroad for Queer Refugees (IRQR) - Toronto-based
adds.summary: Iranian transgender persons subjected to human rights abuse based on gender identity flee Iran to Türkiye to seek UNHCR asylum, and since 2008-10-08 receive basic necessities, financial aid and private sponsorship for resettlement to Canada through IRQR with Marjan Foundation despite prolonged resettlement waiting periods.
